verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto hote etelesen ho Iēsous pantas tous logous toutous eipen tois mathētais autou
verses.literal: When Jesus had finished saying all these things He told . . . His disciples
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU que, quando Jesus concluiu todos estes discursos, disse aos seus discípulos:

verses.original: Οἴδατε ὅτι μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας τὸ πάσχα γίνεται καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς τὸ σταυρωθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Oidate hoti meta dyo hēmeras to pascha ginetai kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradidotai eis to staurōthēnai
verses.literal: You know that the Passover is two days away and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified
verses.literalPt: Bem sabeis que daqui a dois dias é a páscoa; e o Filho do homem será entregue para ser crucificado.

verses.original: Τότε συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τοῦ λεγομένου Καϊάφα
verses.transliteration: Tote synēchthēsan hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi tou laou eis tēn aulēn tou archiereōs tou legomenou Kaiapha
verses.literal: At that time the chief priests and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest whose name was Caiaphas
verses.literalPt: Depois os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os anciãos do povo reuniram-se na sala do sumo sacerdote, o qual se chamava Caifás.

verses.original: καὶ συνεβουλεύσαντο ἵνα τὸν Ἰησοῦν δόλῳ κρατήσωσιν καὶ ἀποκτείνωσιν
verses.transliteration: kai synebouleusanto hina ton Iēsoun dolō kratēsōsin kai apokteinōsin
verses.literal: and they conspired to arrest Jesus covertly and kill Him
verses.literalPt: E consultaram-se mutuamente para prenderem Jesus com dolo e o matarem.

verses.original: ἔλεγον δέ Μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ ἵνα μὴ θόρυβος γένηται ἐν τῷ λαῷ
verses.transliteration: elegon de Mē en tē heortē hina mē thorybos genētai en tō laō
verses.literal: But not during the feast they said or . . . there may be a riot among the people
verses.literalPt: Mas diziam: Não durante a festa, para que não haja alvoroço entre o povo.

verses.original: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γενομένου ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ
verses.transliteration: Tou de Iēsou genomenou en Bēthania en oikia Simōnos tou leprou
verses.literal: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper
verses.literalPt: E, estando Jesus em Betânia, em casa de Simão, o leproso,

verses.original: προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου βαρυτίμου καὶ κατέχεεν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ ἀνακειμένου
verses.transliteration: prosēlthen autō gynē echousa alabastron myrou barytimou kai katecheen epi tēs kephalēs autou anakeimenou
verses.literal: a woman came to Him with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume which she poured on His head as He reclined at the table
verses.literalPt: Aproximou-se dele uma mulher com um vaso de alabastro, com ungüento de grande valor, e derramou-lho sobre a cabeça, quando ele estava assentado à mesa.

verses.original: Ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἠγανάκτησαν λέγοντες Εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη
verses.transliteration: Idontes de hoi mathētai ēganaktēsan legontes Eis ti hē apōleia hautē
verses.literal: When the disciples saw this they were indignant and asked Why . . . this waste
verses.literalPt: E os seus discípulos, vendo isto, indignaram-se, dizendo: Por que é este desperdício?

verses.original: ἐδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο πραθῆναι πολλοῦ καὶ δοθῆναι πτωχοῖς
verses.transliteration: edynato gar touto prathēnai pollou kai dothēnai ptōchois
verses.literal: This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor
verses.literalPt: Pois este ungüento podia vender-se por grande preço, e dar-se o dinheiro aos pobres.

verses.original: Γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί κόπους παρέχετε τῇ γυναικί ἔργον γὰρ καλὸν ἠργάσατο εἰς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: Gnous de ho Iēsous eipen autois Ti kopous parechete tē gynaiki ergon gar kalon ērgasato eis eme
verses.literal: Aware of this Jesus asked Why are you bothering . . . this woman She has done a beautiful deed to Me
verses.literalPt: Jesus, porém, conhecendo isto, disse-lhes: Por que afligis esta mulher? pois praticou uma boa ação para comigo.

verses.original: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε
verses.transliteration: pantote gar tous ptōchous echete meth’ heautōn eme de ou pantote echete
verses.literal: The poor you will always have with you but you will not always have Me
verses.literalPt: Porquanto sempre tendes convosco os pobres, mas a mim não me haveis de ter sempre.

verses.original: βαλοῦσα γὰρ αὕτη τὸ μύρον τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ σώματός μου πρὸς τὸ ἐνταφιάσαι με ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: balousa gar hautē to myron touto epi tou sōmatos mou pros to entaphiasai me epoiēsen
verses.literal: By pouring this perfume on Me she has prepared My . . . body for burial
verses.literalPt: Ora, derramando ela este ungüento sobre o meu corpo, fê-lo preparando-me para o meu sepultamento.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅπου ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦτο ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ κόσμῳ λαληθήσεται καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hopou ean kērychthē to euangelion touto en holō tō kosmō lalēthēsetai kai ho epoiēsen hautē eis mnēmosynon autēs
verses.literal: Truly I tell you wherever . . . this gospel is preached in all the world what she has done will also be told in memory of her
verses.literalPt: Em verdade vos digo que, onde quer que este evangelho for pregado em todo o mundo, também será referido o que ela fez, para memória sua.

verses.original: Τότε πορευθεὶς εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας Ἰσκαριώτης πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς
verses.transliteration: Tote poreutheis heis tōn dōdeka ho legomenos Ioudas Iskariōtēs pros tous archiereis
verses.literal: Then one of the Twelve the one called Judas Iscariot went to the chief priests
verses.literalPt: Então um dos doze, chamado Judas Iscariotes, foi ter com os príncipes dos sacerdotes,

verses.original: εἶπεν Τί θέλετέ μοι δοῦναι κἀγὼ ὑμῖν παραδώσω αὐτόν οἱ δὲ ἔστησαν αὐτῷ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια
verses.transliteration: eipen Ti thelete moi dounai kagō hymin paradōsō auton hoi de estēsan autō triakonta argyria
verses.literal: and asked What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you And they set out for him thirty pieces of silver
verses.literalPt: E disse: Que me quereis dar, e eu vo-lo entregarei? E eles lhe pesaram trinta moedas de prata,

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ τότε ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν ἵνα αὐτὸν παραδῷ
verses.transliteration: kai apo tote ezētei eukairian hina auton paradō
verses.literal: So from then on Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus
verses.literalPt: E desde então buscava oportunidade para o entregar.

verses.original: Τῇ δὲ πρώτῃ τῶν ἀζύμων προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες Ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμέν σοι φαγεῖν τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Tē de prōtē tōn azymōn prosēlthon hoi mathētai tō Iēsou legontes Pou theleis hetoimasōmen soi phagein to pascha
verses.literal: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread the disciples came to Jesus and asked Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover
verses.literalPt: E, no primeiro dia da festa dos pães ázimos, chegaram os discípulos junto de Jesus, dizendo: Onde queres que façamos os preparativos para comeres a páscoa?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν πρὸς τὸν δεῖνα καὶ εἴπατε αὐτῷ Ὁ Διδάσκαλος λέγει Ὁ καιρός μου ἐγγύς ἐστιν πρὸς σὲ ποιῶ τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Hypagete eis tēn polin pros ton deina kai eipate autō HO Didaskalos legei Ho kairos mou engys estin pros se poiō to pascha meta tōn mathētōn mou
verses.literal: He answered Go into the city to a certain man and tell him that the Teacher says My time is near I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Ide à cidade, a um certo homem, e dizei-lhe: O Mestre diz: O meu tempo está próximo; em tua casa celebrarei a páscoa com os meus discípulos.

verses.original: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὡς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: kai epoiēsan hoi mathētai hōs synetaxen autois ho Iēsous kai hētoimasan to pascha
verses.literal: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover
verses.literalPt: E os discípulos fizeram como Jesus lhes ordenara, e prepararam a páscoa.

verses.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἀνέκειτο μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα μαθητῶν
verses.transliteration: Opsias de genomenēs anekeito meta tōn dōdeka mathētōn
verses.literal: When evening came Jesus was reclining with the twelve disciples
verses.literalPt: E, chegada a tarde, assentou-se à mesa com os doze.

verses.original: καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν εἶπεν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με
verses.transliteration: kai esthiontōn autōn eipen Amēn legō hymin hoti heis ex hymōn paradōsei me
verses.literal: And while they were eating He said to them Truly I tell you one of you will betray Me
verses.literalPt: E, comendo eles, disse: Em verdade vos digo que um de vós me há de trair.

verses.original: Καὶ λυπούμενοι σφόδρα ἤρξαντο λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς ἕκαστος Μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριε
verses.transliteration: Kai lypoumenoi sphodra ērxanto legein autō heis hekastos Mēti egō eimi Kyrie
verses.literal: They were deeply grieved . . . and began to ask Him one after another Surely not . . . I Lord
verses.literalPt: E eles, entristecendo-se muito, começaram cada um a dizer-lhe: Porventura sou eu, SENHOR?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ὁ ἐμβάψας μετ’ ἐμοῦ τὴν χεῖρα ἐν τῷ τρυβλίῳ οὗτός με παραδώσει
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Ho embapsas met’ emou tēn cheira en tō trybliō houtos me paradōsei
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me
verses.literalPt: E ele, respondendo, disse: O que põe comigo a mão no prato, esse me há de trair.

verses.original: ὁ μὲν Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι’ οὗ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται καλὸν ἦν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος
verses.transliteration: ho men Huios tou anthrōpou hypagei kathōs gegraptai peri autou ouai de tō anthrōpō ekeinō di’ hou ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradidotai kalon ēn autō ei ouk egennēthē ho anthrōpos ekeinos
verses.literal: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him but woe to that man by whom He . . . . . . . . . is betrayed It would be better for him if he . . . . . . had not been born
verses.literalPt: Em verdade o Filho do homem vai, como acerca dele está escrito, mas ai daquele homem por quem o Filho do homem é traído! Bom seria para esse homem se não houvera nascido.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν εἶπεν Μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι ῥαββί Λέγει αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶπας
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de Ioudas ho paradidous auton eipen Mēti egō eimi rhabbi Legei autō Sy eipas
verses.literal: Then Judas who would betray Him said . . . Surely not I Rabbi Jesus answered . . . You have said it yourself
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo Judas, o que o traía, disse: Porventura sou eu, Rabi? Ele disse: Tu o disseste.

verses.original: Ἐσθιόντων δὲ αὐτῶν λαβὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἄρτον καὶ εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ δοὺς τοῖς μαθηταῖς εἶπεν Λάβετε φάγετε τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου
verses.transliteration: Esthiontōn de autōn labōn ho Iēsous arton kai eulogēsas eklasen kai dous tois mathētais eipen Labete phagete touto estin to sōma mou
verses.literal: While they were eating Jesus took bread spoke a blessing and broke it and gave it to the disciples saying Take and eat this is My body
verses.literalPt: E, quando comiam, Jesus tomou o pão, e abençoando-o, o partiu, e o deu aos discípulos, e disse: Tomai, comei, isto é o meu corpo.

verses.original: Καὶ λαβὼν ποτήριον καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων Πίετε ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες
verses.transliteration: Kai labōn potērion kai eucharistēsas edōken autois legōn Piete ex autou pantes
verses.literal: Then He took the cup gave thanks and gave it to them saying Drink from it all of you
verses.literalPt: E, tomando o cálice, e dando graças, deu-lho, dizendo: Bebei dele todos;

verses.original: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου τῆς διαθήκης τὸ περὶ πολλῶν ἐκχυννόμενον εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: touto gar estin to haima mou tēs diathēkēs to peri pollōn ekchynnomenon eis aphesin hamartiōn
verses.literal: This is My blood of the covenant which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins
verses.literalPt: Porque isto é o meu sangue, o sangue do novo testamento, que é derramado por muitos, para remissão dos pecados.

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπ’ ἄρτι ἐκ τούτου τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω μεθ’ ὑμῶν καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Πατρός μου
verses.transliteration: legō de hymin ou mē piō ap’ arti ek toutou tou genēmatos tēs ampelou heōs tēs hēmeras ekeinēs hotan auto pinō meth’ hymōn kainon en tē basileia tou Patros mou
verses.literal: I tell you I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in My Father’s kingdom
verses.literalPt: E digo-vos que, desde agora, não beberei deste fruto da vide, até aquele dia em que o beba novo convosco no reino de meu Pai.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hymnēsantes exēlthon eis to oros tōn Elaiōn
verses.literal: And when they had sung a hymn they went out to the Mount of Olives
verses.literalPt: E, tendo cantado o hino, saíram para o Monte das Oliveiras.

verses.original: Τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πάντες ὑμεῖς σκανδαλισθήσεσθε ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ γέγραπται γάρ Πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα Καὶ διασκορπισθήσονται τὰ πρόβατα τῆς ποίμνης
verses.transliteration: Tote legei autois ho Iēsous Pantes hymeis skandalisthēsesthe en emoi en tē nykti tautē gegraptai gar Pataxō ton poimena Kai diaskorpisthēsontai ta probata tēs poimnēs
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to them This very night you will all fall away on account of Me For it is written I will strike the Shepherd and the sheep of the flock will be scattered
verses.literalPt: Então Jesus lhes disse: Todos vós esta noite vos escandalizareis em mim; porque está escrito: Ferirei o pastor, e as ovelhas do rebanho se dispersarão.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν
verses.transliteration: Meta de to egerthēnai me proaxō hymas eis tēn Galilaian
verses.literal: But after I have risen I will go ahead of you into Galilee
verses.literalPt: Mas, depois de eu ressuscitar, irei adiante de vós para a Galiléia.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εἰ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται ἐν σοί ἐγὼ οὐδέποτε σκανδαλισθήσομαι
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Petros eipen autō Ei pantes skandalisthēsontai en soi egō oudepote skandalisthēsomai
verses.literal: Peter said to Him Even if all fall away on account of You I never will
verses.literalPt: Mas Pedro, respondendo, disse-lhe: Ainda que todos se escandalizem em ti, eu nunca me escandalizarei.

verses.original: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρὶς ἀπαρνήσῃ με
verses.transliteration: Ephē autō ho Iēsous Amēn legō soi hoti en tautē tē nykti prin alektora phōnēsai tris aparnēsē me
verses.literal: Truly I tell you Jesus declared - this very night before the rooster crows you will deny Me three times
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Em verdade te digo que, nesta mesma noite, antes que o galo cante, três vezes me negarás.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος Κἂν δέῃ με σὺν σοὶ ἀποθανεῖν οὐ μή σε ἀπαρνήσομαι ὁμοίως καὶ πάντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἶπαν
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Petros Kan deē me syn soi apothanein ou mē se aparnēsomai homoiōs kai pantes hoi mathētai eipan
verses.literal: Peter replied Even if I have to . . . die with You I will never deny You And all the other disciples said the same thing
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Ainda que me seja mister morrer contigo, não te negarei. E todos os discípulos disseram o mesmo.

verses.original: Τότε ἔρχεται μετ’ αὐτῶν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς χωρίον λεγόμενον Γεθσημανὶ καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς Καθίσατε αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀπελθὼν ἐκεῖ προσεύξωμαι
verses.transliteration: Tote erchetai met’ autōn ho Iēsous eis chōrion legomenon Gethsēmani kai legei tois mathētais Kathisate autou heōs hou apelthōn ekei proseuxōmai
verses.literal: Then Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane and He told them Sit here while . . . I go over there and pray
verses.literalPt: Então chegou Jesus com eles a um lugar chamado Getsêmani, e disse a seus discípulos: Assentai-vos aqui, enquanto vou além orar.

verses.original: Καὶ παραλαβὼν τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς Ζεβεδαίου ἤρξατο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai paralabōn ton Petron kai tous dyo huious Zebedaiou ērxato lypeisthai kai adēmonein
verses.literal: He took with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee and began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed
verses.literalPt: E, levando consigo Pedro e os dois filhos de Zebedeu, começou a entristecer-se e a angustiar-se muito.

verses.original: τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς Περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε μετ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: tote legei autois Perilypos estin hē psychē mou heōs thanatou meinate hōde kai grēgoreite met’ emou
verses.literal: Then He said to them My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death Stay here and keep watch with Me
verses.literalPt: Então lhes disse: A minha alma está cheia de tristeza até a morte; ficai aqui, e velai comigo.

verses.original: Καὶ προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ προσευχόμενος καὶ λέγων Πάτερ μου εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν παρελθάτω ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦτο πλὴν οὐχ ὡς ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλ’ ὡς σύ
verses.transliteration: Kai proelthōn mikron epesen epi prosōpon autou proseuchomenos kai legōn Pater mou ei dynaton estin parelthatō ap’ emou to potērion touto plēn ouch hōs egō thelō all’ hōs sy
verses.literal: Going a little farther He fell facedown and prayed - My Father if it is possible let this cup pass from Me Yet not as I will but as You will
verses.literalPt: E, indo um pouco mais para diante, prostrou-se sobre o seu rosto, orando e dizendo: Meu Pai, se é possível, passe de mim este cálice; todavia, não seja como eu quero, mas como tu queres.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ Οὕτως οὐκ ἰσχύσατε μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι μετ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai erchetai pros tous mathētas kai heuriskei autous katheudontas kai legei tō Petrō Houtōs ouk ischysate mian hōran grēgorēsai met’ emou
verses.literal: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour He asked Peter
verses.literalPt: E, voltando para os seus discípulos, achou-os adormecidos; e disse a Pedro: Então nem uma hora pudeste velar comigo?

verses.original: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής
verses.transliteration: grēgoreite kai proseuchesthe hina mē eiselthēte eis peirasmon to men pneuma prothymon hē de sarx asthenēs
verses.literal: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation For the spirit is willing but the body is weak
verses.literalPt: Vigiai e orai, para que não entreis em tentação; na verdade, o espírito está pronto, mas a carne é fraca.

verses.original: Πάλιν ἐκ δευτέρου ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο λέγων Πάτερ μου εἰ οὐ δύναται τοῦτο παρελθεῖν ἐὰν μὴ αὐτὸ πίω γενηθήτω τὸ θέλημά σου
verses.transliteration: Palin ek deuterou apelthōn prosēuxato legōn Pater mou ei ou dynatai touto parelthein ean mē auto piō genēthētō to thelēma sou
verses.literal: A second time He went away and prayed My Father if this cup cannot pass unless . . . I drink it may Your will be done
verses.literalPt: E, indo segunda vez, orou, dizendo: Pai meu, se este cálice não pode passar de mim sem eu o beber, faça-se a tua vontade.

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν πάλιν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ βεβαρημένοι
verses.transliteration: kai elthōn palin heuren autous katheudontas ēsan gar autōn hoi ophthalmoi bebarēmenoi
verses.literal: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping for their eyes were heavy
verses.literalPt: E, voltando, achou-os outra vez adormecidos; porque os seus olhos estavam pesados.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀφεὶς αὐτοὺς πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο ἐκ τρίτου τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπὼν πάλιν
verses.transliteration: Kai apheis autous palin apelthōn prosēuxato ek tritou ton auton logon eipōn palin
verses.literal: So He left them and went away once more and prayed a third time saying the same thing
verses.literalPt: E, deixando-os de novo, foi orar pela terceira vez, dizendo as mesmas palavras.

verses.original: τότε ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Καθεύδετε τὸ λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς χεῖρας ἁμαρτωλῶν
verses.transliteration: tote erchetai pros tous mathētas kai legei autois Katheudete to loipon kai anapauesthe idou ēngiken hē hōra kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradidotai eis cheiras hamartōlōn
verses.literal: Then He returned to the disciples and said Are you still sleeping . . . . . . and resting Look the hour is near and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners
verses.literalPt: Então chegou junto dos seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Dormi agora, e repousai; eis que é chegada a hora, e o Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos pecadores.

verses.original: ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ὁ παραδιδούς με
verses.transliteration: egeiresthe agōmen idou ēngiken ho paradidous me
verses.literal: Rise let us go See My betrayer is approaching
verses.literalPt: Levantai-vos, partamos; eis que é chegado o que me trai.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ἦλθεν καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ὄχλος πολὺς μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai eti autou lalountos idou Ioudas heis tōn dōdeka ēlthen kai met’ autou ochlos polys meta machairōn kai xylōn apo tōn archiereōn kai presbyterōn tou laou
verses.literal: While Jesus was still speaking Judas one of the Twelve arrived accompanied by . . . a large crowd armed with swords and clubs sent from the chief priests and elders of the people
verses.literalPt: E, estando ele ainda a falar, eis que chegou Judas, um dos doze, e com ele grande multidão com espadas e varapaus, enviada pelos príncipes dos sacerdotes e pelos anciãos do povo.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς σημεῖον λέγων Ὃν ἂν φιλήσω αὐτός ἐστιν κρατήσατε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ho de paradidous auton edōken autois sēmeion legōn Hon an philēsō autos estin kratēsate auton
verses.literal: Now the betrayer . . . had arranged a signal with them The One I kiss is the man arrest Him
verses.literalPt: E o que o traía tinha-lhes dado um sinal, dizendo: O que eu beijar é esse; prendei-o.

verses.original: καὶ εὐθέως προσελθὼν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπεν Χαῖρε ῥαββί καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai eutheōs proselthōn tō Iēsou eipen Chaire rhabbi kai katephilēsen auton
verses.literal: Going directly to Jesus he said Greetings Rabbi and kissed Him
verses.literalPt: E logo, aproximando-se de Jesus, disse: Eu te saúdo, Rabi; e beijou-o.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἑταῖρε ἐφ’ ὃ πάρει Τότε προσελθόντες ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen autō Hetaire eph’ ho parei Tote proselthontes epebalon tas cheiras epi ton Iēsoun kai ekratēsan auton
verses.literal: Friend - Jesus replied do what you came for Then the men stepped forward seized . . . . . . . . . Jesus and arrested Him
verses.literalPt: Jesus, porém, lhe disse: Amigo, a que vieste? Então, aproximando-se eles, lançaram mão de Jesus, e o prenderam.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς τῶν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἀπέσπασεν τὴν μάχαιραν αὐτοῦ καὶ πατάξας τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτίον
verses.transliteration: kai idou heis tōn meta Iēsou ekteinas tēn cheira apespasen tēn machairan autou kai pataxas ton doulon tou archiereōs apheilen autou to ōtion
verses.literal: At this . . . one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest cutting off his ear
verses.literalPt: E eis que um dos que estavam com Jesus, estendendo a mão, puxou da espada e, ferindo o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortou-lhe uma orelha.

verses.original: Τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀπόστρεψον τὴν μάχαιράν σου εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς πάντες γὰρ οἱ λαβόντες μάχαιραν ἐν μαχαίρῃ ἀπολοῦνται
verses.transliteration: Tote legei autō ho Iēsous Apostrepson tēn machairan sou eis ton topon autēs pantes gar hoi labontes machairan en machairē apolountai
verses.literal: Put your sword back in its place Jesus said to him For all who draw the sword will die by the sword
verses.literalPt: Então Jesus disse-lhe: Embainha a tua espada; porque todos os que lançarem mão da espada, à espada morrerão.

verses.original: ἢ δοκεῖς ὅτι οὐ δύναμαι παρακαλέσαι τὸν Πατέρα μου καὶ παραστήσει μοι ἄρτι πλείω δώδεκα λεγιῶνας ἀγγέλων
verses.transliteration: ē dokeis hoti ou dynamai parakalesai ton Patera mou kai parastēsei moi arti pleiō dōdeka legiōnas angelōn
verses.literal: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father and He will at once put at My disposal . . . . . . more than twelve legions of angels
verses.literalPt: Ou pensas tu que eu não poderia agora orar a meu Pai, e que ele não me daria mais de doze legiões de anjos?

verses.original: πῶς οὖν πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαὶ ὅτι οὕτως δεῖ γενέσθαι
verses.transliteration: pōs oun plērōthōsin hai graphai hoti houtōs dei genesthai
verses.literal: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way
verses.literalPt: Como, pois, se cumpririam as Escrituras, que dizem que assim convém que aconteça?

verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ὄχλοις Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων συλλαβεῖν με καθ’ ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐκαθεζόμην διδάσκων καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με
verses.transliteration: En ekeinē tē hōra eipen ho Iēsous tois ochlois Hōs epi lēstēn exēlthate meta machairōn kai xylōn syllabein me kath’ hēmeran en tō hierō ekathezomēn didaskōn kai ouk ekratēsate me
verses.literal: At that time Jesus said to the crowd Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw Every day I sat teaching in the temple courts and you did not arrest Me
verses.literalPt: Então disse Jesus à multidão: Saístes, como para um salteador, com espadas e varapaus para me prender? Todos os dias me assentava junto de vós, ensinando no templo, e não me prendestes.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαὶ τῶν προφητῶν Τότε οἱ μαθηταὶ πάντες ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἔφυγον
verses.transliteration: Touto de holon gegonen hina plērōthōsin hai graphai tōn prophētōn Tote hoi mathētai pantes aphentes auton ephygon
verses.literal: But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled
verses.literalPt: Mas tudo isto aconteceu para que se cumpram as escrituras dos profetas. Então, todos os discípulos, deixando-o, fugiram.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ κρατήσαντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπήγαγον πρὸς Καϊάφαν τὸν ἀρχιερέα ὅπου οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι συνήχθησαν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de kratēsantes ton Iēsoun apēgagon pros Kaiaphan ton archierea hopou hoi grammateis kai hoi presbyteroi synēchthēsan
verses.literal: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to the house of Caiaphas the high priest where the scribes and elders had gathered
verses.literalPt: E os que prenderam a Jesus o conduziram à casa do sumo sacerdote Caifás, onde os escribas e os anciãos estavam reunidos.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἕως τῆς αὐλῆς τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ εἰσελθὼν ἔσω ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν ὑπηρετῶν ἰδεῖν τὸ τέλος
verses.transliteration: ho de Petros ēkolouthei autō apo makrothen heōs tēs aulēs tou archiereōs kai eiselthōn esō ekathēto meta tōn hypēretōn idein to telos
verses.literal: But Peter followed Him at a distance right up to the courtyard of the high priest And he went in and sat down with the guards to see the outcome
verses.literalPt: E Pedro o seguiu de longe, até ao pátio do sumo sacerdote e, entrando, assentou-se entre os criados, para ver o fim.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τὸ συνέδριον ὅλον ἐζήτουν ψευδομαρτυρίαν κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὅπως αὐτὸν θανατώσωσιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de archiereis kai to synedrion holon ezētoun pseudomartyrian kata tou Iēsou hopōs auton thanatōsōsin
verses.literal: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Ora, os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os anciãos, e todo o conselho, buscavam falso testemunho contra Jesus, para poderem dar-lhe a morte;

verses.original: καὶ οὐχ εὗρον πολλῶν προσελθόντων ψευδομαρτύρων Ὕστερον δὲ προσελθόντες δύο
verses.transliteration: kai ouch heuron pollōn proselthontōn pseudomartyrōn Hysteron de proselthontes dyo
verses.literal: But they did not find any though many false witnesses came forward Finally . . . two came forward
verses.literalPt: E não o achavam; apesar de se apresentarem muitas testemunhas falsas, não o achavam. Mas, por fim chegaram duas testemunhas falsas,

verses.original: εἶπαν Οὗτος ἔφη Δύναμαι καταλῦσαι τὸν ναὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τριῶν ἡμερῶν οἰκοδομῆσαι
verses.transliteration: eipan Houtos ephē Dynamai katalysai ton naon tou Theou kai dia triōn hēmerōn oikodomēsai
verses.literal: and declared This man said I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days
verses.literalPt: E disseram: Este disse: Eu posso derrubar o templo de Deus, e reedificá-lo em três dias.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Οὐδὲν ἀποκρίνῃ τί οὗτοί σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai anastas ho archiereus eipen autō Ouden apokrinē ti houtoi sou katamartyrousin
verses.literal: So the high priest stood up and asked Him Have You no answer . . . What are these men testifying against You
verses.literalPt: E, levantando-se o sumo sacerdote, disse-lhe: Não respondes coisa alguma ao que estes depõem contra ti?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐσιώπα Καὶ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἐξορκίζω σε κατὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος ἵνα ἡμῖν εἴπῃς εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous esiōpa Kai ho archiereus eipen autō Exorkizō se kata tou Theou tou zōntos hina hēmin eipēs ei sy ei ho Christos ho Huios tou Theou
verses.literal: But Jesus remained silent Then the high priest said to Him I charge You under oath . . . by the living God Tell us if You are the Christ the Son of God
verses.literalPt: Jesus, porém, guardava silêncio. E, insistindo o sumo sacerdote, disse-lhe: Conjuro-te pelo Deus vivo que nos digas se tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Σὺ εἶπας πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπ’ ἄρτι ὄψεσθε τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καθήμενον ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐρχόμενον ἐπὶ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Sy eipas plēn legō hymin ap’ arti opsesthe ton Huion tou anthrōpou kathēmenon ek dexiōn tēs dynameōs kai erchomenon epi tōn nephelōn tou ouranou
verses.literal: You have said it yourself Jesus answered . . . But I say to all of you from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Tu o disseste; digo-vos, porém, que vereis em breve o Filho do homem assentado à direita do Poder, e vindo sobre as nuvens do céu.

verses.original: Τότε ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ λέγων Ἐβλασφήμησεν τί ἔτι χρείαν ἔχομεν μαρτύρων ἴδε νῦν ἠκούσατε τὴν βλασφημίαν
verses.transliteration: Tote ho archiereus dierrēxen ta himatia autou legōn Eblasphēmēsen ti eti chreian echomen martyrōn ide nyn ēkousate tēn blasphēmian
verses.literal: At this the high priest tore his clothes and declared He has blasphemed Why do we need any more witnesses Look now you have heard the blasphemy
verses.literalPt: Então o sumo sacerdote rasgou as suas vestes, dizendo: Blasfemou; para que precisamos ainda de testemunhas? Eis que bem ouvistes agora a sua blasfêmia.

verses.original: τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ Οἱ δὲ ἀποκριθέντες εἶπαν Ἔνοχος θανάτου ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: ti hymin dokei Hoi de apokrithentes eipan Enochos thanatou estin
verses.literal: What do you think He deserves to die - they answered . . .
verses.literalPt: Que vos parece? E eles, respondendo, disseram: É réu de morte.

verses.original: Τότε ἐνέπτυσαν εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκολάφισαν αὐτόν οἱ δὲ ἐράπισαν
verses.transliteration: Tote eneptysan eis to prosōpon autou kai ekolaphisan auton hoi de erapisan
verses.literal: Then they spit in His face and struck Him Others slapped Him
verses.literalPt: Então cuspiram-lhe no rosto e lhe davam punhadas, e outros o esbofeteavam,

verses.original: λέγοντες Προφήτευσον ἡμῖν Χριστέ τίς ἐστιν ὁ παίσας σε
verses.transliteration: legontes Prophēteuson hēmin Christe tis estin ho paisas se
verses.literal: and said Prophesy to us Christ Who . . . . . . hit You
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Profetiza-nos, Cristo, quem é o que te bateu?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἐκάθητο ἔξω ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ καὶ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ μία παιδίσκη λέγουσα Καὶ σὺ ἦσθα μετὰ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Γαλιλαίου
verses.transliteration: Ho de Petros ekathēto exō en tē aulē kai prosēlthen autō mia paidiskē legousa Kai sy ēstha meta Iēsou tou Galilaiou
verses.literal: Meanwhile Peter was sitting out in the courtyard and a servant girl came up to him You also were with Jesus the Galilean she said
verses.literalPt: Ora, Pedro estava assentado fora, no pátio; e, aproximando-se dele uma criada, disse: Tu também estavas com Jesus, o galileu.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο ἔμπροσθεν πάντων λέγων Οὐκ οἶδα τί λέγεις
verses.transliteration: Ho de ērnēsato emprosthen pantōn legōn Ouk oida ti legeis
verses.literal: But he denied it before them all I do not know what you are talking about
verses.literalPt: Mas ele negou diante de todos, dizendo: Não sei o que dizes.

verses.original: Ἐξελθόντα δὲ εἰς τὸν πυλῶνα εἶδεν αὐτὸν ἄλλη καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἐκεῖ Οὗτος ἦν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου
verses.transliteration: Exelthonta de eis ton pylōna eiden auton allē kai legei tois ekei Houtos ēn meta Iēsou tou Nazōraiou
verses.literal: When Peter had gone out to the gateway another servant girl saw him and said to the people there This man was with Jesus of Nazareth
verses.literalPt: E, saindo para o vestíbulo, outra criada o viu, e disse aos que ali estavam: Este também estava com Jesus, o Nazareno.

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν ἠρνήσατο μετὰ ὅρκου ὅτι Οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: Kai palin ērnēsato meta horkou hoti Ouk oida ton anthrōpon
verses.literal: And again he denied it with an oath I do not know the man
verses.literalPt: E ele negou outra vez com juramento: Não conheço tal homem.

verses.original: Μετὰ μικρὸν δὲ προσελθόντες οἱ ἑστῶτες εἶπον τῷ Πέτρῳ Ἀληθῶς καὶ σὺ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ καὶ γὰρ ἡ λαλιά σου δῆλόν σε ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: Meta mikron de proselthontes hoi hestōtes eipon tō Petrō Alēthōs kai sy ex autōn ei kai gar hē lalia sou dēlon se poiei
verses.literal: After a little while those standing nearby came up to Peter Surely you are one of them they said for your accent gives you away
verses.literalPt: E, daí a pouco, aproximando-se os que ali estavam, disseram a Pedro: Verdadeiramente também tu és deles, pois a tua fala te denuncia.

verses.original: Τότε ἤρξατο καταθεματίζειν καὶ ὀμνύειν ὅτι Οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον Καὶ εὐθέως ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν
verses.transliteration: Tote ērxato katathematizein kai omnyein hoti Ouk oida ton anthrōpon Kai eutheōs alektōr ephōnēsen
verses.literal: At that he began to curse and swear to them I do not know the man And immediately a rooster crowed
verses.literalPt: Então começou ele a praguejar e a jurar, dizendo: Não conheço esse homem. E imediatamente o galo cantou.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τοῦ ῥήματος Ἰησοῦ εἰρηκότος ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρὶς ἀπαρνήσῃ με καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἔξω ἔκλαυσεν πικρῶς
verses.transliteration: Kai emnēsthē ho Petros tou rhēmatos Iēsou eirēkotos hoti Prin alektora phōnēsai tris aparnēsē me kai exelthōn exō eklausen pikrōs
verses.literal: Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken Before the rooster crows you will deny Me three times And he went outside and wept bitterly
verses.literalPt: E lembrou-se Pedro das palavras de Jesus, que lhe dissera: Antes que o galo cante, três vezes me negarás. E, saindo dali, chorou amargamente.
